# Welcome Consultancy

> India's premier Foreign Trade & DGFT advisory firm (10+ years, 1000+ clients, 25+ EXIM services).

## About

Welcome Consultancy helps Indian exporters and importers with DGFT licensing, customs compliance, and export incentive optimization.
Phone: +91 98330 62670 / +91 97691 48981.
Website: https://welcomeconsultancy.in

## Services Portfolio (26 DGFT Services)

### 1. Licensing Services
- [RoDTEP & RoSCTL Application](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/rodtep-rosctl-application): Remission of duties and taxes on exported products.
- [Sale & Purchase of All Duty Credit Scrips](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/sale-purchase-duty-credit-scrips): RoDTEP, RoSCTL, and MEIS scrip trading desk.
- [EPCG & Advance License & Closures](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/epcg-advance-license-closures): Zero-duty capital goods and duty-free raw material import authorisations and EODC redemption.
- [SCOMET License](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/scomet-license): Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies export clearance.
- [DFIA License & Transfer](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/dfia-license-transferable): Duty Free Import Authorisation and transferable market endorsement.

### 2. Registration Services
- [IEC Code Updation & New Application](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/iec-code-registration): 10-digit DGFT import-export code generation and annual profile renewals.
- [AD Code Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/ad-code-registration): Authorized Dealer code registration across Indian customs ports.
- [SIMS Registration for Steel Import](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/sims-registration): Steel Import Monitoring System mandatory filings.
- [ICEGATE Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/icegate-registration): Customs EDI portal onboarding, DSC registration, and e-SANCHIT.
- [Various Council (RCMC) Registration & Renewal](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/rcmc-registration-renewal): Export Promotion Council membership certificates.
- [REX Registration Services](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/rex-registration): Registered Exporter System for EU/UK self-certification.
- [EPR Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/epr-registration): Extended Producer Responsibility registration for plastic packaging, battery, and electronic waste.

### 3. Certification Services
- [Certificate of Origin (Preferential / Non-Preferential)](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/certificate-of-origin): Trade agreement certification (CEPA, ISAFTA, SAFTA, FORM A1).
- [Health Certificate](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/health-certificate): Veterinary and phytosanitary clearance for food/agri exports.
- [Interest Equalization Scheme](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/interest-equalization-scheme): Export credit interest subvention advisory for MSME manufacturers.
- [AEO Registration Services](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/aeo-registration): Authorized Economic Operator T1/T2 certification.
- [Status Holder Certificate (Star Export House)](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/star-export-house): 1-Star to 5-Star export house accreditation.
- [FSSAI Central Registration](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/fssai-central-registration): Central food license for import/export operations.
- [Free Sale Certificate](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/free-sale-certificate): DGFT certificate of free sale for foreign market product registration.
- [Legalization of Export Documents](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/legalization-of-export-documents): Chamber of Commerce, MEA Apostille, and embassy consular attestation.

### 4. Other Export Related Work
- [Pending Duty Drawback Matter Follow-up](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/pending-duty-drawback): Recovery of stuck drawback claims and ICEGATE scroll generation.
- [IGST Refund Claim & Error Resolution](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/igst-refund-claim): Resolution of SB005/SB001 invoice and port mismatches.
- [Digital Signature (Class 3 / IEC)](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/digital-signature-certificate): FIPS-compliant cryptographic USB tokens for DGFT and ICEGATE.
- [Export Consultancy Services](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/export-consultancy-services): Strategic Foreign Trade Policy (FTP 2023) advisory.
- [Export Documentation Services](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/export-documentation-services): Complete pre-shipment and post-shipment documentation desk.
- [Reply to Customs & DGFT Notices](https://welcomeconsultancy.in/service/reply-customs-dgft-notices): Show Cause Notice (SCN) drafting and regulatory dispute representation.
